title: 40 Claude Code sessions a day, and every decision is still mine: Hookah House
author: bahaw1024
selftext:
I'm a software engineer building Hookah House (hookah lounge sim, Godot) mostly solo. Claude Code writes most of the code. I'm the architect: I make every design call and approve every plan.

How it works:
- Nested sessions: "hub" sessions (Backlog, Bug Central) start one child session per bug or ticket, so each one has a clean context. Children report back and the hub checks the diff.
- Backlog + Linear: every feature gets broken into tickets with acceptance criteria. I set scope and order.
- Design first: Claude builds an interactive HTML design page for any new UI or mechanic. I pick the direction before any code is written.
- CI: GitHub Actions runs headless Godot tests. Nothing is "done" until it's green.
- Tuning: Claude's balance numbers ship as flagged drafts. I set the real values by playtesting.

Other AI: Meshy/Tripo (3D), Suno (music), ElevenLabs (voices), and live NPC chat on Claude Haiku.

If you want to follow progress or talk shop, come hang out on the Discord: https://discord.gg/uVThPXvWgN

Happy to answer questions.
